One-time setup

TV Share uses two free, open-source helpers. They install in a minute or two, with Windows' own installer.

  • rcloneShows your movie folder to the TV
  • FFmpegPuts subtitles inside movies so the TV shows them

Windows treats this network as public. If your TV can't find this PC, set the network to Private. Only do this on your home Wi-Fi.

Watch on your TV

  1. Keep this app open and the PC awake, on the same Wi-Fi as the TV.
  2. On the TV, open VLC (free in the TV's app store).
  3. Go to Browse → Local network → your PC.

Also works with Kodi, game consoles and most smart-TV media players. The first time, if Windows asks whether to allow access on the network, click Allow.
